validated_results.title: Alkylresorcinol metabolites in urine and plasma as potential biomarkers of rye and wheat fiber consumption in prostate cancer patients and controls.
validated_results.reason: The study only validates alkylresorcinol metabolites in urine/plasma as biomarkers of rye/wheat fiber intake in existing prostate cancer patients versus controls, providing no estimate of risk of developing prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Vitamin K: the missing link to prostate health.
validated_results.reason: This is a hypothesis/commentary article proposing vitamin K insufficiency as a cause of benign prostatic hyperplasia, presenting no original comparative data on prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: A precisely substituted benzopyran targets androgen refractory prostate cancer cells through selective modulation of estrogen receptors.
validated_results.reason: The work is exclusively preclinical, testing a benzopyran compound and genistein in PC-3 and COS cell lines rather than in humans.

validated_results.title: Heart healthy equals prostate healthy and statins, aspirin, and/or metformin (S.A.M.) are the ideal recommendations for prostate cancer prevention.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review/opinion piece discussing cardiovascular-based prevention recommendations and prior trials rather than reporting an original human study.

validated_results.title: Tomato paste alters NF-κB and cancer-related mRNA expression in prostate cancer cells, xenografts, and xenograft microenvironment.

validated_results.title: Tomato paste alters NF-κB and cancer-related mRNA expression in prostate cancer cells, xenografts, and xenograft microenvironment.
validated_results.reason: Tomato paste was fed to xenograft-bearing nude mice and applied to cultured prostate cancer cells, with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Genetic variants in the inositol phosphate metabolism pathway and risk of different types of cancer.
validated_results.reason: The exposure studied is germline genetic variation in the inositol phosphate metabolism pathway, not nutritional inositol intake or status.

validated_results.title: The anti-cancer effects of carotenoids and other phytonutrients resides in their combined activity.
validated_results.reason: Lycopene combinations were tested only in in vitro reporter gene assays in prostate cancer cell lines without human participants.
